cond_0001.intro: The scope for the team is very wide. This role would coordinate measures for the assembly facility to prepare equipment installations. They could coordinate concrete, foundations, tool, secondary media installations (network/lighting/compressed air etc.). They would coordinate activities in a certain area of the assembly hall. This person will focus mainly on construction related to assembly halls, but not the assembly halls themselves, the structures to install equipment and conveyors for assembly processes. It's more what's inside the building, not the construction of the assembly hall.
cond_0001.responsibilities:
Position Purpose/Scope:
Plans / coordinates installation of structure related systems for existing and new models in conjunction with process requirements.
Monitors and evaluates the structure systems' operational, technical, and maintenance status as they relate to the overall system performance, design specification, and the total throughput of the assembly facility.
Structure Planning:
Coordinates the modification and distribution of the structural aspects of the assembly buildings ensuring that the structural integrity and distribution of utilities are maintained.
Coordinates / plans all structure refurbishments / modifications to facility as required (including: truss reinforcements, utility relocation, concrete replacement, resurfacing and painting of floors, and investment planning / tracking).
Develops and maintains a working relationship with contractors, facilities engineering central planning.
Oversees visiting contractors on site and advises on civil engineering issues.
Ensures that assembly remains in line with all code issues (i.e., Fire Marshall, Insurance Company).
Evaluates and reports on the impact of model allocation on the assembly structure.
Establishes and maintains standards & specifications.
Coordinates technical and feasibility studies and site investigations with Facilities Group.
Coordinates the assessment of potential risks of specific projects, undertakes risk management in specialist roles.
Supervises tendering procedures and proposal formulation.
Coordinates the effective communication and liaison with colleagues, architects, subcontractors, contracting civil engineers, consultants, co-workers and clients.
Manages budgets and other project resources for all projects assigned. Reviews and approves project drawings.
Coordinates the compilation and approval of all construction reports.
Coordinates adoption of all relevant requirements around issues such as building permits, environmental regulations, sanitary design, good manufacturing practices and safety on all work assignments.
Leads the correcting of any project deficiencies that affect production, quality and safety requirements prior to final evaluation and project reviews.
Planning of secondary media.
Support Conveyor Planning:
Supports planning activities for conveyor refurbishments, modifications / installations including: concept, design approval, specifications, RFQ, schedule, installation, commissioning, startup, training, buyoff, and investment planning / tracking.
Authorizes/approves all system modifications and assists in their development where necessary.
Continually evaluates system performance to improve efficiency and reliability.
Provides cost estimates for system modification or extraordinary maintenance items as requested by maintenance planning.
Develops and maintains expertise in the following as they relate to conveyors: modifications, engineering, standards & specification, and system functional design capabilities.
Familiar with the engineering, maintenance, operations, and administrative procedures and policies that govern plant operations including technical specification & safety.
cond_0001.requirements:
Minimum Requirements:
BS degree in Mechanical, Electrical or Industrial Engineering, or equivalent 4 years of related engineering experience.
2+ Years of engineering experience in a manufacturing environment.
1 Year of project management experience.
Preferred Requirements:
Automotive manufacturing background.
Coordination of construction sites and knowledge of primary and secondary media (planning installation of electricity, network jobs, compressed air, etc.).

This role involves staying in regular contact with contractors, engineers, and internal teams to coordinate equipment installations at the assembly facility — including concrete, foundations, tooling, and secondary media (network, lighting, compressed air, etc.). The focus is on the structures inside the assembly hall that support equipment and conveyors for assembly processes, not the construction of the hall itself.
cond_0105.responsibilities:
Position Purpose/Scope:
Plans and coordinates installation of structure-related systems for existing and new models in line with process requirements. Monitors and evaluates structural systems' operational, technical, and maintenance status as they relate to overall system performance, design specifications, and total throughput of the assembly facility.
Structure Planning:
Coordinates the modification and distribution of structural aspects of the assembly buildings, staying in close contact with contractors and internal teams to ensure structural integrity and utility distribution are maintained.
Coordinates and plans all structure refurbishments and modifications to the facility as required (including truss reinforcements, utility relocation, concrete replacement, resurfacing and painting of floors, and investment planning/tracking).
Develops and maintains an active working relationship with contractors and facilities engineering central planning.
Oversees visiting contractors on site and advises on civil engineering issues, handling questions and clarifying requirements as they arise.
Ensures that assembly remains in line with all code issues (i.e., Fire Marshall, Insurance Company).
Evaluates and reports on the impact of model allocation on the assembly structure.
Establishes and maintains standards and specifications.
Coordinates technical and feasibility studies and site investigations with the Facilities Group, regularly connecting with relevant colleagues to align on findings.
Coordinates the assessment of potential risks of specific projects and undertakes risk management in specialist roles.
Supervises tendering procedures and proposal formulation.
Coordinates effective communication and liaison with colleagues, architects, subcontractors, contracting civil engineers, consultants, co-workers, and clients on a regular basis.
Manages budgets and other project resources for all assigned projects. Reviews and approves project drawings.
Coordinates the compilation and approval of all construction reports.
Coordinates adoption of all relevant requirements around building permits, environmental regulations, sanitary design, good manufacturing practices, and safety on all work assignments.
Leads the correction of any project deficiencies that affect production, quality, and safety requirements prior to final evaluation and project reviews.
Planning of secondary media.
Support Conveyor Planning:
Supports planning activities for conveyor refurbishments, modifications, and installations including concept, design approval, specifications, RFQ, schedule, installation, commissioning, startup, training, buyoff, and investment planning/tracking. Actively contributes to discussions with relevant teams throughout each phase.
Authorizes and approves all system modifications and assists in their development where necessary.
Continually evaluates system performance to improve efficiency and reliability.
Provides cost estimates for system modifications or extraordinary maintenance items as requested by maintenance planning, walking stakeholders through the reasoning where needed.
Develops and maintains expertise in conveyor-related modifications, engineering, standards and specifications, and system functional design capabilities.
Familiar with the engineering, maintenance, operations, and administrative procedures and policies that govern plant operations, including technical specifications and safety.
cond_0105.requirements:
BS degree in Mechanical, Electrical, or Industrial Engineering, or the equivalent of 4 years of related engineering experience.
2+ Years of engineering experience in a manufacturing environment (automotive preferred), including 1 year of project management experience.
Project management experience.
Coordination of construction sites and knowledge of primary and secondary media (planning installation of electricity, network, compressed air, etc.).

cond_0114.intro: The scope for this team is very wide. This role coordinates measures for the assembly facility to prepare equipment installations — covering concrete, foundations, tooling, and secondary media installations (network, lighting, compressed air, etc.). The focus is mainly on structures inside the assembly hall: the structures needed to install equipment and conveyors for assembly processes, not the construction of the hall itself.
cond_0114.responsibilities:
Structure Planning:
Regularly coordinates the modification and distribution of structural aspects of assembly buildings, staying in close contact with contractors and facilities engineering central planning to ensure structural integrity and utility distribution are maintained.
Coordinates and plans all structure refurbishments and modifications to the facility as needed (including truss reinforcements, utility relocation, concrete replacement, floor resurfacing and painting, and investment planning and tracking).
Actively engages with visiting contractors on site and advises on civil engineering issues.
Ensures assembly remains in line with all code requirements (e.g., Fire Marshall, Insurance Company).
Evaluates and reports on the impact of model allocation on the assembly structure.
Establishes and maintains standards and specifications.
Coordinates technical and feasibility studies and site investigations with the Facilities Group.
Coordinates the assessment of potential project risks and takes on risk management in specialist roles.
Supervises tendering procedures and proposal formulation.
Actively communicates and liaises with colleagues, architects, subcontractors, contracting civil engineers, consultants, co-workers, and clients on an ongoing basis.
Manages budgets and other project resources for all assigned projects. Reviews and approves project drawings.
Coordinates the compilation and approval of all construction reports.
Coordinates adoption of all relevant requirements around building permits, environmental regulations, sanitary design, good manufacturing practices, and safety on all work assignments.
Leads the correction of any project deficiencies affecting production, quality, and safety prior to final evaluation and project reviews.
Planning of secondary media.
Support Conveyor Planning:
Supports planning activities for conveyor refurbishments, modifications, and installations including concept, design approval, specifications, RFQ, schedule, installation, commissioning, startup, training, buyoff, and investment planning and tracking.
Authorizes and approves all system modifications and actively contributes to their development where needed.
Continually evaluates system performance to improve efficiency and reliability.
Provides cost estimates for system modifications or extraordinary maintenance items as requested by maintenance planning.
Develops and maintains expertise in conveyor-related modifications, engineering, standards and specifications, and system functional design.
Familiar with engineering, maintenance, operations, and administrative procedures and policies governing plant operations, including technical specifications and safety.
cond_0114.requirements:
Minimum Requirements:
BS degree in Mechanical, Electrical, or Industrial Engineering, or equivalent of 4 years of related engineering experience.
2+ Years of engineering experience in a manufacturing environment.
1 Year of project management experience.
Preferred Requirements:
Automotive manufacturing background.
Experience coordinating construction sites.
Knowledge of primary and secondary media planning (electricity, network, compressed air, etc.).

This person will focus mainly on construction related to assembly halls, but not the assembly halls themselves, the structures to install equipment and conveyors for assembly processes. It's more what's inside the building, not the construction of the assembly hall.
cond_0282.responsibilities:
Position Purpose/Scope:
Plans / coordinates installation of structure related systems for existing and new models in conjunction with process requirements.
Monitors and evaluates the structure systems' operational, technical, and maintenance status as they relate to the overall system performance, design specification, and the total throughput of the assembly facility.
Structure Planning:
Coordinates the modification and distribution of the structural aspects of the assembly buildings ensuring that the structural integrity and distribution of utilities are maintained.
Coordinates / plans all structure refurbishments / modifications to facility as required (including: truss reinforcements, utility relocation, concrete replacement, resurfacing and painting of floors, and investment planning / tracking).
Develops and maintains a working relationship with contractors, facilities engineering central planning.
Oversees visiting contractors on site and advises on civil engineering issues.
Ensures that assembly remains in line with all code issues (i.e., Fire Marshall, Insurance Company).
Evaluates and reports on the impact of model allocation on the assembly structure.
Establishes and maintains standards & specifications.
Coordinates technical and feasibility studies and site investigations with Facilities Group.
Coordinates the assessment of potential risks of specific projects, undertakes risk management in specialist roles.
Supervises tendering procedures and proposal formulation.
Coordinates the effective communication and liaison with colleagues, architects, subcontractors, contracting civil engineers, consultants, co-workers and clients.
Manages budgets and other project resources for all projects assigned. Reviews and approves project drawings.
Coordinates the compilation and approval of all construction reports.
Coordinates adoption of all relevant requirements around issues such as building permits, environmental regulations, sanitary design, good manufacturing practices and safety on all work assignments.
Leads the correcting of any project deficiencies that affect production, quality and safety requirements prior to final evaluation and project reviews.
Planning of secondary media.
Support Conveyor Planning:
Supports planning activities for conveyor refurbishments, modifications / installations including: concept, design approval, specifications, RFQ, schedule, installation, commissioning, startup, training, buyoff, and investment planning / tracking.
Authorizes/approves all system modifications and assists in their development where necessary.
Continually evaluates system performance to improve efficiency and reliability.
Provides cost estimates for system modification or extraordinary maintenance items as requested by maintenance planning.
Develops and maintains working knowledge in the following as they relate to conveyors: modifications, engineering, standards & specification, and system functional design capabilities.
Familiar with the engineering, maintenance, operations, and administrative procedures and policies that govern plant operations including technical specification & safety.
cond_0282.requirements:
BS degree in Mechanical, Electrical or Industrial Engineering, or equivalent practical experience (such as 4 years of related engineering experience).
Around 2 years of engineering experience in a manufacturing environment (automotive experience is a plus), including some exposure to project management — ideally around 1 year.
Background in project management; willingness to develop further in this area is welcome.
Some experience coordinating construction sites and familiarity with primary and secondary media (such as electricity, network, compressed air, etc.). We consider candidates who are still building knowledge in these areas.
cond_0282.values: We value excellence, focus, and the ability to produce strong outcomes. We believe organizations succeed when they hold themselves to a high bar.

This person will focus mainly on construction related to assembly halls, but not the assembly halls themselves, the structures to install equipment and conveyors for assembly processes. It's more what's inside the building, not the construction of the assembly hall.
cond_0372.responsibilities:
Position Purpose/Scope:
Plans / coordinates installation of structure related systems for existing and new models in conjunction with process requirements.
Monitors and evaluates the structure systems' operational, technical, and maintenance status as they relate to the overall system performance, design specification, and the total throughput of the assembly facility.
Structure Planning:
Coordinates the modification and distribution of the structural aspects of the assembly buildings ensuring that the structural integrity and distribution of utilities are maintained.
Coordinates / plans all structure refurbishments / modifications to facility as required (including: truss reinforcements, utility relocation, concrete replacement, resurfacing and painting of floors, and investment planning / tracking).
Develops and maintains a working relationship with contractors, facilities engineering central planning.
Oversees visiting contractors on site and advises on civil engineering issues.
Ensures that assembly remains in line with all code issues (i.e., Fire Marshall, Insurance Company).
Evaluates and reports on the impact of model allocation on the assembly structure.
Establishes and maintains standards & specifications.
Coordinates technical and feasibility studies and site investigations with Facilities Group.
Coordinates the assessment of potential risks of specific projects, undertakes risk management in specialist roles.
Supervises tendering procedures and proposal formulation.
Coordinates the effective communication and liaison with colleagues, architects, subcontractors, contracting civil engineers, consultants, co-workers and clients.
Manages budgets and other project resources for all projects assigned. Reviews and approves project drawings.
Coordinates the compilation and approval of all construction reports.
Coordinates adoption of all relevant requirements around issues such as building permits, environmental regulations, sanitary design, good manufacturing practices and safety on all work assignments.
Leads the correcting of any project deficiencies that affect production, quality and safety requirements prior to final evaluation and project reviews.
Planning of secondary media.
Support Conveyor Planning:
Supports planning activities for conveyor refurbishments, modifications / installations including: concept, design approval, specifications, RFQ, schedule, installation, commissioning, startup, training, buyoff, and investment planning / tracking.
Authorizes/approves all system modifications and assists in their development where necessary.
Continually evaluates system performance to improve efficiency and reliability.
Provides cost estimates for system modification or extraordinary maintenance items as requested by maintenance planning.
Develops and maintains working knowledge in the following as they relate to conveyors: modifications, engineering, standards & specification, and system functional design capabilities.
Familiar with the engineering, maintenance, operations, and administrative procedures and policies that govern plant operations including technical specification & safety.
cond_0372.requirements:
BS degree in Mechanical, Electrical or Industrial Engineering, or equivalent practical experience (such as 4 years of related engineering experience).
Around 2 years of engineering experience in a manufacturing environment (automotive experience is a plus), including some exposure to project management — ideally around 1 year.
Background in project management; willingness to develop further in this area is welcome.
Some experience coordinating construction sites and familiarity with primary and secondary media (such as electricity, network, compressed air, etc.). We consider candidates who are still building knowledge in these areas.

cond_0390.intro: Day to day: The scope for the team is very wide. This role would coordinate measures for the assembly facility to prepare equipment installations. They could coordinate concrete, foundations, tool, secondary media installations (network/lighting/compressed air etc.). They would coordinate activities in a certain area of the assembly hall. This person will focus mainly on construction related to assembly halls, but not the assembly halls themselves, the structures to install equipment and conveyors for assembly processes. It's more what's inside the building, not the construction of the assembly hall.
cond_0390.responsibilities:
Position Purpose/Scope:
Plans / coordinates installation of structure related systems for existing and new models in conjunction with process requirements.
Monitors and evaluates the structure systems' operational, technical, and maintenance status as they relate to the overall system performance, design specification, and the total throughput of the assembly facility.
Structure Planning:
Coordinates the modification and distribution of the structural aspects of the assembly buildings ensuring that the structural integrity and distribution of utilities are maintained.
Coordinates / plans all structure refurbishments / modifications to facility as required (including: truss reinforcements, utility relocation, concrete replacement, resurfacing and painting of floors, and investment planning / tracking).
Develops and maintains a working relationship with contractors, facilities engineering central planning.
Oversees visiting contractors on site and advises on civil engineering issues.
Ensures that assembly remains in line with all code issues (i.e., Fire Marshall, Insurance Company).
Evaluates and reports on the impact of model allocation on the assembly structure.
Establishes and maintains standards & specifications.
Coordinates technical and feasibility studies and site investigations with Facilities Group.
Coordinates the assessment of potential risks of specific projects, undertakes risk management in specialist roles.
Supervises tendering procedures and proposal formulation.
Coordinates the effective communication and liaison with colleagues, architects, subcontractors, contracting civil engineers, consultants, co-workers and clients.
Manages budgets and other project resources for all projects assigned. Reviews and approves project drawings.
Coordinates the compilation and approval of all construction reports.
Coordinates adoption of all relevant requirements around issues such as building permits, environmental regulations, sanitary design, good manufacturing practices and safety on all work assignments.
Leads the correcting of any project deficiencies that affect production, quality and safety requirements prior to final evaluation and project reviews.
Planning of secondary media.
Support Conveyor Planning:
Supports planning activities for conveyor refurbishments, modifications / installations including: concept, design approval, specifications, RFQ, schedule, installation, commissioning, startup, training, buyoff, and investment planning / tracking.
Authorizes/approves all system modifications and assists in their development where necessary.
Continually evaluates system performance to improve efficiency and reliability.
Provides cost estimates for system modification or extraordinary maintenance items as requested by maintenance planning.
Develops and maintains working knowledge in the following as they relate to conveyors: modifications, engineering, standards & specification, and system functional design capabilities.
Familiar with the engineering, maintenance, operations, and administrative procedures and policies that govern plant operations including technical specification & safety.
cond_0390.requirements:
BS degree in Mechanical, Electrical or Industrial Engineering, or equivalent practical experience (such as 4 years of related engineering experience).
Around 2 years of engineering experience in a manufacturing environment (automotive experience is a plus), including some exposure to project management — ideally around 1 year.
Background in project management; willingness to develop further in this area is welcome.
Some experience coordinating construction sites and familiarity with primary and secondary media (such as electricity, network, compressed air, etc.). We consider candidates who are still building knowledge in these areas.

The focus is mainly on construction related to assembly halls — specifically the structures needed to install equipment and conveyors for assembly processes, not the assembly halls themselves. Most people become stronger in this kind of coordination work over time as they build experience across projects and learn from the contractors and teams they work with.
cond_0455.responsibilities:
Structure Planning:
Coordinates the modification and distribution of the structural aspects of the assembly buildings ensuring that the structural integrity and distribution of utilities are maintained.
Coordinates / plans all structure refurbishments / modifications to facility as required (including: truss reinforcements, utility relocation, concrete replacement, resurfacing and painting of floors, and investment planning / tracking).
Develops and maintains a working relationship with contractors, facilities engineering central planning.
Oversees visiting contractors on site and advises on civil engineering issues.
Ensures that assembly remains in line with all code issues (i.e., Fire Marshall, Insurance Company).
Evaluates and reports on the impact of model allocation on the assembly structure.
Establishes and maintains standards & specifications.
Coordinates technical and feasibility studies and site investigations with Facilities Group.
Coordinates the assessment of potential risks of specific projects, undertakes risk management in specialist roles.
Supervises tendering procedures and proposal formulation.
Coordinates the effective communication and liaison with colleagues, architects, subcontractors, contracting civil engineers, consultants, co-workers and clients.
Manages budgets and other project resources for all projects assigned. Reviews and approves project drawings.
Coordinates the compilation and approval of all construction reports.
Coordinates adoption of all relevant requirements around issues such as building permits, environmental regulations, sanitary design, good manufacturing practices and safety on all work assignments.
Leads the correcting of any project deficiencies that affect production, quality and safety requirements prior to final evaluation and project reviews.
Planning of secondary media.
Support Conveyor Planning:
Supports planning activities for conveyor refurbishments, modifications / installations including: concept, design approval, specifications, RFQ, schedule, installation, commissioning, startup, training, buyoff, and investment planning / tracking.
Authorizes/approves all system modifications and assists in their development where necessary.
Continually evaluates system performance to improve efficiency and reliability.
Provides cost estimates for system modification or extraordinary maintenance items as requested by maintenance planning.
Develops and maintains expertise in the following as they relate to conveyors: modifications, engineering, standards & specification, and system functional design capabilities.
Familiar with the engineering, maintenance, operations, and administrative procedures and policies that govern plant operations including technical specification & safety.
cond_0455.requirements:
Minimum Requirements:
BS degree in Mechanical, Electrical or Industrial Engineering, or equivalent of 4 years related engineering experience.
2+ Years of engineering experience in a manufacturing environment.
1 Year of project management experience.
Preferred Requirements:
Automotive manufacturing background.
Coordination of construction sites and knowledge of primary and secondary media (planning installation of electricity, network jobs, compressed air, etc.).

This person will focus mainly on construction related to assembly halls, but not the assembly halls themselves, the structures to install equipment and conveyors for assembly processes. It's more what's inside the building, not the construction of the assembly hall. People usually grow into this role over time as they build experience with structural coordination and construction planning in manufacturing environments.
cond_0464.responsibilities:
Structure Planning:
Coordinates the modification and distribution of the structural aspects of the assembly buildings ensuring that the structural integrity and distribution of utilities are maintained.
Coordinates / plans all structure refurbishments / modifications to facility as required (including: truss reinforcements, utility relocation, concrete replacement, resurfacing and painting of floors, and investment planning / tracking).
Develops and maintains a working relationship with contractors, facilities engineering central planning.
Oversees visiting contractors on site and advises on civil engineering issues.
Ensures that assembly remains in line with all code issues (i.e., Fire Marshall, Insurance Company).
Evaluates and reports on the impact of model allocation on the assembly structure.
Establishes and maintains standards & specifications.
Coordinates technical and feasibility studies and site investigations with Facilities Group.
Coordinates the assessment of potential risks of specific projects, undertakes risk management in specialist roles.
Supervises tendering procedures and proposal formulation.
Coordinates the effective communication and liaison with colleagues, architects, subcontractors, contracting civil engineers, consultants, co-workers and clients.
Manages budgets and other project resources for all projects assigned. Reviews and approves project drawings.
Coordinates the compilation and approval of all construction reports.
Coordinates adoption of all relevant requirements around issues such as building permits, environmental regulations, sanitary design, good manufacturing practices and safety on all work assignments.
Leads the correcting of any project deficiencies that affect production, quality and safety requirements prior to final evaluation and project reviews.
Planning of secondary media.
Support Conveyor Planning:
Supports planning activities for conveyor refurbishments, modifications / installations including: concept, design approval, specifications, RFQ, schedule, installation, commissioning, startup, training, buyoff, and investment planning / tracking.
Authorizes/approves all system modifications and assists in their development where necessary.
Continually evaluates system performance to improve efficiency and reliability.
Provides cost estimates for system modification or extraordinary maintenance items as requested by maintenance planning.
Develops and maintains expertise in the following as they relate to conveyors: modifications, engineering, standards & specification, and system functional design capabilities.
Familiar with the engineering, maintenance, operations, and administrative procedures and policies that govern plant operations including technical specification & safety.
cond_0464.requirements:
BS degree in Mechanical, Electrical or Industrial engineering or the equivalent of 4 years related engineering experience.
2+ Years of engineering experience in a manufacturing environment (automotive preferred), to include 1 year project management experience.
Project management experience.
Coordination of construction sites and knowledge of primary and secondary media (planning installation of electricity, network jobs, compressed air, etc.).

cond_0465.intro: We are looking for a Structural Engineer to join our team. The scope for the team is very wide. This role involves staying in regular contact with contractors, engineers, and internal teams to coordinate equipment installations at the assembly facility — including concrete, foundations, tooling, and secondary media (network, lighting, compressed air, etc.). The focus is on the structures inside the assembly hall that support equipment and conveyors for assembly processes, not the construction of the hall itself.

Plans and coordinates installation of structure-related systems for existing and new models in line with process requirements. Monitors and evaluates structural systems' operational, technical, and maintenance status as they relate to overall system performance, design specifications, and total throughput of the assembly facility.
Structure Planning:
Coordinates the modification and distribution of structural aspects of the assembly buildings, staying in close contact with contractors and internal teams to ensure structural integrity and utility distribution are maintained.
Coordinates and plans all structure refurbishments and modifications to the facility as required (including truss reinforcements, utility relocation, concrete replacement, resurfacing and painting of floors, and investment planning/tracking).
Develops and maintains an active working relationship with contractors and facilities engineering central planning.
Oversees visiting contractors on site and advises on civil engineering issues, handling questions and clarifying requirements as they arise.
Ensures that assembly remains in line with all code issues (i.e., Fire Marshall, Insurance Company).
Evaluates and reports on the impact of model allocation on the assembly structure.
Establishes and maintains standards and specifications.
Coordinates technical and feasibility studies and site investigations with the Facilities Group, regularly connecting with relevant colleagues to align on findings.
Coordinates the assessment of potential risks of specific projects and undertakes risk management in specialist roles.
Supervises tendering procedures and proposal formulation.
Coordinates effective communication and liaison with colleagues, architects, subcontractors, contracting civil engineers, consultants, co-workers, and clients on a regular basis.
Manages budgets and other project resources for all assigned projects. Reviews and approves project drawings.
Coordinates the compilation and approval of all construction reports.
Coordinates adoption of all relevant requirements around building permits, environmental regulations, sanitary design, good manufacturing practices, and safety on all work assignments.
Leads the correction of any project deficiencies that affect production, quality, and safety requirements prior to final evaluation and project reviews.
Planning of secondary media.
Support Conveyor Planning:
Supports planning activities for conveyor refurbishments, modifications, and installations including concept, design approval, specifications, RFQ, schedule, installation, commissioning, startup, training, buyoff, and investment planning/tracking. Actively contributes to discussions with relevant teams throughout each phase.
Authorizes and approves all system modifications and assists in their development where necessary.
Continually evaluates system performance to improve efficiency and reliability.
Provides cost estimates for system modifications or extraordinary maintenance items as requested by maintenance planning, walking stakeholders through the reasoning where needed.
Develops and maintains expertise in conveyor-related modifications, engineering, standards and specifications, and system functional design capabilities.
Familiar with the engineering, maintenance, operations, and administrative procedures and policies that govern plant operations, including technical specifications and safety.
cond_0465.requirements:
BS degree in Mechanical, Electrical, or Industrial Engineering, or the equivalent of 4 years of related engineering experience.
2+ Years of engineering experience in a manufacturing environment (automotive preferred), including 1 year of project management experience.
Project management experience.
Coordination of construction sites and knowledge of primary and secondary media (planning installation of electricity, network, compressed air, etc.).

cond_0473.intro: The scope for this team is very wide. This role coordinates measures for the assembly facility to prepare equipment installations, including concrete, foundations, tools, and secondary media installations (network/lighting/compressed air, etc.). The focus is mainly on construction related to assembly halls — specifically the structures needed to install equipment and conveyors for assembly processes, not the assembly halls themselves. Most people become stronger in this kind of coordination work over time as they build experience across projects and learn from the contractors and teams they work with.
cond_0473.responsibilities:
Structure Planning:
Coordinates the modification and distribution of the structural aspects of the assembly buildings ensuring that the structural integrity and distribution of utilities are maintained.
Coordinates / plans all structure refurbishments / modifications to facility as required (including: truss reinforcements, utility relocation, concrete replacement, resurfacing and painting of floors, and investment planning / tracking).
Develops and maintains a working relationship with contractors, facilities engineering central planning.
Oversees visiting contractors on site and advises on civil engineering issues.
Ensures that assembly remains in line with all code issues (i.e., Fire Marshall, Insurance Company).
Evaluates and reports on the impact of model allocation on the assembly structure.
Establishes and maintains standards & specifications.
Coordinates technical and feasibility studies and site investigations with Facilities Group.
Coordinates the assessment of potential risks of specific projects, undertakes risk management in specialist roles.
Supervises tendering procedures and proposal formulation.
Coordinates the effective communication and liaison with colleagues, architects, subcontractors, contracting civil engineers, consultants, co-workers and clients.
Manages budgets and other project resources for all projects assigned. Reviews and approves project drawings.
Coordinates the compilation and approval of all construction reports.
Coordinates adoption of all relevant requirements around issues such as building permits, environmental regulations, sanitary design, good manufacturing practices and safety on all work assignments.
Leads the correcting of any project deficiencies that affect production, quality and safety requirements prior to final evaluation and project reviews.
Planning of secondary media.
Support Conveyor Planning:
Supports planning activities for conveyor refurbishments, modifications / installations including: concept, design approval, specifications, RFQ, schedule, installation, commissioning, startup, training, buyoff, and investment planning / tracking.
Authorizes/approves all system modifications and assists in their development where necessary.
Continually evaluates system performance to improve efficiency and reliability.
Provides cost estimates for system modification or extraordinary maintenance items as requested by maintenance planning.
Develops and maintains expertise in the following as they relate to conveyors: modifications, engineering, standards & specification, and system functional design capabilities.
Familiar with the engineering, maintenance, operations, and administrative procedures and policies that govern plant operations including technical specification & safety.

cond_0490.intro: The scope for this team is very wide. This role coordinates measures for the assembly facility to prepare equipment installations, including concrete, foundations, tools, and secondary media installations (network/lighting/compressed air, etc.). The focus is mainly on construction related to assembly halls — specifically the structures needed to install equipment and conveyors for assembly processes, not the assembly halls themselves. It's more about what's inside the building. People who do well in this role are often quick to grasp the logic of how structural and installation work fits together in a manufacturing environment.
cond_0490.responsibilities:
Structure Planning:
Coordinates the modification and distribution of the structural aspects of the assembly buildings ensuring that the structural integrity and distribution of utilities are maintained.
Coordinates / plans all structure refurbishments / modifications to facility as required (including: truss reinforcements, utility relocation, concrete replacement, resurfacing and painting of floors, and investment planning / tracking).
Develops and maintains a working relationship with contractors, facilities engineering central planning.
Oversees visiting contractors on site and advises on civil engineering issues.
Ensures that assembly remains in line with all code issues (i.e., Fire Marshall, Insurance Company).
Evaluates and reports on the impact of model allocation on the assembly structure.
Establishes and maintains standards & specifications.
Coordinates technical and feasibility studies and site investigations with Facilities Group.
Coordinates the assessment of potential risks of specific projects, undertakes risk management in specialist roles.
Supervises tendering procedures and proposal formulation.
Coordinates the effective communication and liaison with colleagues, architects, subcontractors, contracting civil engineers, consultants, co-workers and clients.
Manages budgets and other project resources for all projects assigned. Reviews and approves project drawings.
Coordinates the compilation and approval of all construction reports.
Coordinates adoption of all relevant requirements around issues such as building permits, environmental regulations, sanitary design, good manufacturing practices and safety on all work assignments.
Leads the correcting of any project deficiencies that affect production, quality and safety requirements prior to final evaluation and project reviews.
Planning of secondary media.
Support Conveyor Planning:
Supports planning activities for conveyor refurbishments, modifications / installations including: concept, design approval, specifications, RFQ, schedule, installation, commissioning, startup, training, buyoff, and investment planning / tracking.
Authorizes/approves all system modifications and assists in their development where necessary.
Continually evaluates system performance to improve efficiency and reliability.
Provides cost estimates for system modification or extraordinary maintenance items as requested by maintenance planning.
Develops and maintains expertise in the following as they relate to conveyors: modifications, engineering, standards & specification, and system functional design capabilities.
Familiar with the engineering, maintenance, operations, and administrative procedures and policies that govern plant operations including technical specification & safety.
cond_0490.requirements:
Minimum Requirements:
BS degree in Mechanical, Electrical or Industrial Engineering, or 4 years of related engineering experience.
2+ Years of engineering experience in a manufacturing environment.
1 Year of project management experience.
Preferred Requirements:
Automotive manufacturing background.
Experience coordinating construction sites and knowledge of primary and secondary media (electricity, network, compressed air, etc.).

cond_0508.intro: The scope for this team is very wide. This role coordinates measures for the assembly facility to prepare equipment installations, including concrete, foundations, tools, and secondary media installations (network/lighting/compressed air, etc.). The focus is mainly on construction related to assembly halls — specifically the structures needed to install equipment and conveyors for assembly processes, not the assembly halls themselves. It's more about what's inside the building. People who do well in this role are often quick to grasp the logic of how structural and installation work fits together in a manufacturing environment.
cond_0508.responsibilities:
Structure Planning:
Coordinates the modification and distribution of the structural aspects of the assembly buildings ensuring that the structural integrity and distribution of utilities are maintained.
Coordinates / plans all structure refurbishments / modifications to facility as required (including: truss reinforcements, utility relocation, concrete replacement, resurfacing and painting of floors, and investment planning / tracking).
Develops and maintains a working relationship with contractors, facilities engineering central planning.
Oversees visiting contractors on site and advises on civil engineering issues.
Ensures that assembly remains in line with all code issues (i.e., Fire Marshall, Insurance Company).
Evaluates and reports on the impact of model allocation on the assembly structure.
Establishes and maintains standards & specifications.
Coordinates technical and feasibility studies and site investigations with Facilities Group.
Coordinates the assessment of potential risks of specific projects, undertakes risk management in specialist roles.
Supervises tendering procedures and proposal formulation.
Coordinates the effective communication and liaison with colleagues, architects, subcontractors, contracting civil engineers, consultants, co-workers and clients.
Manages budgets and other project resources for all projects assigned. Reviews and approves project drawings.
Coordinates the compilation and approval of all construction reports.
Coordinates adoption of all relevant requirements around issues such as building permits, environmental regulations, sanitary design, good manufacturing practices and safety on all work assignments.
Leads the correcting of any project deficiencies that affect production, quality and safety requirements prior to final evaluation and project reviews.
Planning of secondary media.
Support Conveyor Planning:
Supports planning activities for conveyor refurbishments, modifications / installations including: concept, design approval, specifications, RFQ, schedule, installation, commissioning, startup, training, buyoff, and investment planning / tracking.
Authorizes/approves all system modifications and assists in their development where necessary.
Continually evaluates system performance to improve efficiency and reliability.
Provides cost estimates for system modification or extraordinary maintenance items as requested by maintenance planning.
Develops and maintains expertise in the following as they relate to conveyors: modifications, engineering, standards & specification, and system functional design capabilities.
Familiar with the engineering, maintenance, operations, and administrative procedures and policies that govern plant operations including technical specification & safety.

2+ Years of engineering experience in a manufacturing environment.
1 Year of project management experience.
Preferred Requirements:
Automotive manufacturing background.
Experience coordinating construction sites and knowledge of primary and secondary media (electricity, network, compressed air, etc.).
